screening.screening_rationale: Patient provides a coherent, well-organized photo description with specific concrete details (lady in white shirt with bracelet, man in button-up shirt with gelled hair, lady in background). Speech is informative, stays on topic, and is appropriate for the task context. No formal thought disorder indicators detected.

Patient provides coherent reasoning in response to follow-up question, explaining observations (looking away, leaning away/forward, positioned half behind). Contains some phrase repetition and conversational fillers (kind of like) typical of informal speech, but maintains logical flow and directly addresses the question. No pathological thought disorder indicators.

Patient provides comprehensive, well-organized description of second photo with multiple specific details (bridge, lady on railing looking down, four men with bags, man in striped shirt, blacked-out sun, buildings with three windows, black and white picture). Uses conversational fillers (like) and sequential connectors (and then) appropriately. Self-corrects spatial description naturally. Speech is coherent, informative, and on-topic.

Patient provides spatially organized description of third photo, progressing logically from foreground to background (girl with braid holding books, lady possibly pregnant, man with horse, houses, water, mountains, trees). Brief repetition about pregnancy observation serves as conversational confirmation rather than pathological perseveration. Appropriate self-correction expressing uncertainty about house count demonstrates normal self-monitoring. Speech is coherent, well-structured, and highly informative.
